title: Consumer Social Feed
summary: Deliver a scrollable home feed that balances freshness, creator content, and safe empty/moderation states.

strategies.name: Following-first chronological
strategies.tradeoffs: Trust and clarity; weaker discovery and session length.

strategies.name: Algorithmic For You default
strategies.tradeoffs: Retention wins; users feel loss of control.
strategies.when: Growth-stage consumer apps optimizing for DAU.

strategies.name: Stories + feed hybrid
strategies.tradeoffs: Ephemeral engagement; UI noise and dual content models.
strategies.when: Visual-first networks with daily check-in habits.

strategies.name: Local/nearby ranking
strategies.tradeoffs: Relevance in place-based apps; privacy and thin supply.

forgottenStates: Zero following empty state with suggestions
neverDo: Infinite autoplay video with sound on
Hide why a post was recommended
Let deleted posts leave broken threads
